camera_policy: RGB-calibrated cameras condition fresh DA3. Convert index to edge once for input; use exact exported cameras for all point backprojection and rerun narrow reconstruction. Generated camera truth is forbidden.
point_policy: All finite positive conditioned depth pixels, complete immutable point IDs, no confidence filtering and no suppression. Four real independent add-only curve patches per object, including empty rejected outcomes.
repeat_policy: Exactly one fresh DA3 subprocess per object. Saved-view reopening is persistence verification, not an independent end-to-end reconstruction repeat.
scope: Normal integration only on two synthetic development assemblies. No readout, GT evaluation, whole-object skeleton, real-capture or G1-pass claim.
